hook.name: DynamicRWAHook
hook.description: Fee hook for ETH/token launch pools that withholds fees from both buys (via beforeSwap delta) and sells (via afterSwap delta), with time-based anti-sniper fee tiers stepping down from 28% to 15% to 2% over the first 200 seconds after LP seeding. Liquidity additions are locked once seeded, and removals are permanently blocked.
